CBSE Group A, B, C Skill Test Admit Card 2026 : Important Question

Question: When will the CBSE Group A, B, C Skill Test Admit Card 2026 be released? Answer: The CBSE Group A, B, C Skill Test admit card 2026 has released online before the Skill Test to help candidates know their allotted examination city.

Question: How can I check the CBSE Group A, B, C Skill Test Admit Card 2026? Answer: Candidates can visit the official CBSE recruitment website, log in using their registration credentials, and download the Exam City Intimation Slip.

Question: Is the Exam City Intimation Slip the same as the Admit Card? Answer: No. The Exam City Intimation Slip only informs candidates about their allotted exam city. The Admit Card is released separately and is required for entry to the examination centre.

Question: What details are mentioned in the Exam City Intimation Slip? Answer: The slip generally contains the candidate’s name, registration number, allotted exam city, exam date, and other important instructions.
Question: What is the official website of the CBSE ? Answer: The official website of the CBSE is https://www.cbse.gov.in/cbsenew/recruitment.html

CBSE Group A, B, C Skill Test Admit Card 2026

Post Date: July 9, 2026

12:21 pm

Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), has released the Skill Test Admit Card on its official website for the recruitment of Group A, B, and C various posts. The skill test will be conducted on 11 July 2026, and the last date to submit the application form was 27 December 2025. Candidates can check their Skill Test Admit Card using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link is provided below. (Advt No. : CBSE/Rectt. Cell/14(88)/2025)
